name: rsuv-vpass
description: RSU VPASS - Vehicle Registration and Pass Management System for Romblon State University (PASO)

scripts.db:check: node -e "import('./server/config/db.js').then(async m => { const h = await m.checkDatabaseHealth(); console.log(JSON.stringify(h, null, 2)); process.exit(h.status === 'connected' ? 0 : 1); })"
scripts.logs:errors: node -e "import('fs').then(f => { const p = './server/logs/error.log'; if (f.existsSync(p)) console.log(f.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); else console.log('No error logs found.'); })"
